stem: ![](asset:P000332-stem-1)Three blocks A = 3 kg, B = 2 kg, C = 5 kg, lie on an inclined frictionless surface as shown in the figure. A force F, parallel to the inclined plane is applied to push the blocks up with an acceleration of 2 m/s<sup>2</sup> . Find the contact force between blocks A and B?

assets.alt: Three blocks in contact on an incline of 30°: A (3 kg), B (2 kg) and C (5 kg). A force F pushes A up the incline, and the blocks accelerate up the slope at 2 m/s².
